release_notes: Build 87 expands Match archive into a detailed read-only Quiz Archive Audit.
The audit lists every unlinked Z: quiz folder, missing-path Quiz History records, ambiguous matches, and existing C:/other-path records that also have a unique confident Z: copy.
Existing C:/other paths are protected: the audit never replaces them automatically and does not move, rename, overwrite or delete files.
Only missing-path records with a unique one-to-one archive match can be explicitly relinked, with a second confirmation before the database path is changed.
Build 86 fixes the Quiz History archive-action visibility bug so Match archive and Archive selected appear reliably.
Build 83 changes Full and Marathon quizzes to a 5-second default and adds safe post-upload archiving.
Build 82 fixes the Questions importer UI and Build 81 adds Open Trivia DB JSON importing with preview, category mapping and duplicate handling.
